ctx.x: Right. So, he got Billy Muir to write a part for himself on guitar and also for Alan Hannon to play on the bass guitar -- and this was the first time that they used a bass guitar. Not a Fender bass -- bass guitar. And I was on drums. So, we played one of the tunes, and we tried to overdub and it didn't work and we tried another tune, and the last tune we tried was "Patricia," and it was still the same thing with no results.

So, Herman said, "Well, I guess we can't do anything with this" -- and that's when I got the bright idea, because I was always suggesting something -- a lot of the guys in the studio used to tell me to keep my mouth shut, but I just couldn't sit there and know that something could happen you know, if I made a suggestion and tried it, it just may work.
